name: Tenaron's Summons
summary: In Shadowglen, Gilshalan Windwalker sends you to meet Tenaron Stormgrip in Aldrassil. Your work against dangers in the woods has brought the elder's attention.

sections.title: A Call to the Boughs
sections.body: Your fight against venomous spiders and corrupted wildlife has reached Tenaron Stormgrip. Gilshalan Windwalker tells you the elder wants to see you. Even night elves know better than to keep an elder waiting atop Aldrassil.

sections.title: Ascending Aldrassil
sections.body: Tenaron waits in Aldrassil's highest chamber and looks across Shadowglen's boughs. His concerns reach beyond the glen, to Teldrassil's moonwells and the corruption spreading through the young World Tree's ecosystem.

faq.answer: Tenaron Stormgrip is a night elf who lives in Aldrassil's highest chamber in Shadowglen. He oversees the glen's spiritual care and the work to watch over and cleanse Teldrassil's sacred waters.

faq.q: Where do I find Tenaron Stormgrip?
faq.answer: Tenaron Stormgrip waits in Aldrassil's highest room, in Shadowglen. Climb the winding ramps inside the great hollow tree to reach his chamber near the crown.
After you prove yourself against the blighted wildlife below, Tenaron gives you greater responsibilities. He asks you to investigate the sacred moonwells and test their waters for corruption.
Meeting Tenaron leads into the Crown of the Earth storyline. He asks you to collect water samples from moonwells across Teldrassil and check the tree's health.
Gilshalan Windwalker sends you to Tenaron after you help him with the venom-crazed Webwood spiders threatening Shadowglen's lower hollows.
Aldrassil is a great tree in Shadowglen. Its hollow trunk holds the central settlement and training sanctuary for young night elves on Teldrassil.

angles.text: As a night elf, this call marks your coming of age among the kaldorei. You move from defending the woods to serving the elders who tend the World Tree.
Meeting Tenaron Stormgrip helps you learn how druids watch over and maintain Teldrassil's balance.
